note: Frameworks are assessment references. Full texts of ISO, IEC, and OWASP were not copied and complete conformity is not claimed. No healthcare jurisdiction is selected.

frameworks.name: WHO Ethics and Governance of Artificial Intelligence for Health
frameworks.applicability: Human oversight, accountability, privacy, and the prohibition on autonomous diagnosis in this development scope.

frameworks.name: WHO Ethics and Governance of AI for Health: Large Multi-Modal Models
frameworks.applicability: Development-time restriction on sending real patient information to a model and on clinical deployment.

frameworks.name: WHO Global Strategy on Digital Health
frameworks.applicability: Governance, workforce safety, and jurisdiction assessment before any deployment.

frameworks.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
frameworks.applicability: Govern, identify, protect, detect, respond, and recover themes for identity and access evidence.

frameworks.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
frameworks.applicability: AI features stay blocked for clinical generation until an intended use is accepted. This run does not score a model.

frameworks.name: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard
frameworks.applicability: Thematic checks for authentication, session, access control, validation, and logging. Not an ASVS certification.

frameworks.name: OWASP API Security Top 10
frameworks.applicability: Object-level and function-level access checks in the domain suite.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27001 Information security management systems
frameworks.applicability: Control objectives for access control, supplier vulnerability evidence, and logging. Not a certification.

frameworks.name: ISO/IEC 27701 Privacy information management systems
frameworks.applicability: Privacy governance is outstanding until Phase 03. The 2025 edition was confirmed as published; its full requirements were not reviewed.

frameworks.name: ISO 14971 Medical devices — Application of risk management
frameworks.applicability: Hazard identification and residual-risk ownership. Not a device risk-management file and not a clinical sign-off.

frameworks.name: IEC 62304 Medical device software life cycle
frameworks.applicability: Software-item traceability and change records for development evidence. Not a device lifecycle claim.

frameworks.name: IEC 62366-1 Medical device usability engineering
frameworks.applicability: Emergency screens exist. No usability engineering file was produced in this run.

frameworks.name: ONC SAFER Guides
frameworks.applicability: System-management, identification, contingency, and communication themes. Not a SAFER attestation.
